changes.name: Caribbean Crown Estate
changes.character: An expansive Saint Lucian sea-view estate arranged as a refined Caribbean pavilion compound: a grand central villa, a south garden salon, an east guest pavilion, and a secluded west guest retreat framing a long resort pool and sunset decks.

summary: Caribbean Crown Estate is a dramatic, approximately $15-million-calibre tropical compound centered on a two-storey ivory main villa. Hip roofs, panoramic glazing, deep verandas, and upper balconies create a resort-like silhouette, while two low covered galleries link the principal social and east guest wings without compromising the pitched-roof composition. A detached west retreat offers privacy, and the north-facing 14-metre pool ensemble provides layered timber sun decks, dining space, and a clear Caribbean-view foreground.
